content: BE 236: Third Council at Pataliputra under Moggaliputta Tissa; Tipitaka fixed and missions dispatched.
verification_target: chronicle tradition versus independent material evidence

content: Mission represented as seven persons: Mahinda, four theras, samanera Sumana and lay follower Bhanduka.
Arrival at Ambasthala on Poson; mango test and teaching before royal conversion.
verification_target: toponym, chronicle sequence and material context

content: Tradition links Mahinda to delimitation of Mahavihara and ordination of local clansmen.
Tradition links Thuparama, Sanghamitta, Bodhi-tree transfer and bhikkhuni foundation.
Stele gives Mahinda death under Uttiya in BE 284, age 80, and relic stupa tradition.
Restored Mihindu Seya completed under temple and Archaeology Department supervision.
Stele names Navy and other armed-forces labour among contributors to restoration.
Completion dated 21 June 2024; commissioning text claims roughly 100,000 devotees.
Seventeen gilded bronze Buddha statues found in an Abhayagiri rampart excavation in August 2026.
Project lead called it the most significant protected-zone find in more than thirty years.
Stylistic comparison suggests seventh-eighth century and roughly 1,200-1,300 years old.
Artefacts sent for further testing; public display anticipated about one month later.
Sacred City of Anuradhapura has World Heritage status since 1982.
AFP frames Abhayagiri as a site of Theravada, Mahayana and Vajrayana currents and international pilgrimage.
